name: QA session
description: QA only (graph-integrity G8.2, D4): a session process running node, a program on the Mac found on the user's PATH; whatever its Say setting is set to is written to the session's input, and each line it answers is logged with its pid, so a check sees the same process fed across idle time.

settings.title: Say
settings.description: Written to the session's input when it changes

args: process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');let b='';process.stdin.on('data',(d)=>{b+=d;let i;while((i=b.indexOf('\n'))>=0){const l=b.slice(0,i);b=b.slice(i+1);console.log('pid '+process.pid+' heard '+JSON.stringify(l)+' at '+new Date().toISOString());}});console.log('pid '+process.pid+' ready in '+process.cwd());
